positive_snippets: I attended an event here and it was a decent experience. Specifically i liked the layout of this hotel the main Hall, the park everything is just where it is supposed to be... The place is nice but there is scope of improvement in staff professionality, No complaints.

The general environment and set up is exceptionally good. The place is neat and clean. Dining is having wide range of food. The staff in particular Shri Vivekanand Chaudhary served and looked after all the guests. I recommend this property needs a visit.
Attended a family function few days ago. The ambiance, food and the staff all were top notch . The hotel manager Mr Vivekanand himself took care of each and everything
